description: This file defines the Response class implementing the ResponseInterface for handling HTTP responses in PSR-7 standard. It includes response status management, reason phrases, and header handling.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, including status, headers, and body, conforming to PSR-7 ResponseInterface.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response object with the specified status code and reason phrase.
